'''2009 2K Event Day 1 Chris Westergard LS Rebel Strike Team''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Westergard]] at [[2009 2K Event]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed|Endor-L-rebelstriketeam.gif}}
* '''Username:''' yodad
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
